title: Legal Metrology Imported Commodities Compliance Rules

rules.name: Country of Origin Mandatory Declaration
rules.description: Rule 6(1)(g): The name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly shall be mentioned on imported packages.
rules.failure_message: Country of Origin not declared on imported commodity package.
rules.remediation: Prominently declare 'Country of Origin: [Country]' or 'Made in [Country]'.

rules.name: Importer Name and Address in India
rules.description: Declaration of registered Indian importer identity and complete address.
rules.remediation: Print 'Imported & Marketed in India by: [Name & Complete Address with PIN]'.

rules.name: Month and Year of Import
rules.description: Declaration of month and year of import into India.
